## 3 — Compressed surface verification (RAN 2026-10-14 — RED, defect found)

15-surface `--expect-renderer spa` suite against `b35473d`; evidence under
`docs/build/reports/2026-10-14_ARMB-surfaces/`. Provenance matched; spend $0 ≤ $5.

**Result classification:**

| Class | Steps | Disposition |
|---|---|---|
| **DEFECT — SPA asset base** | bundle-parity failures on R1/R8/T1/T2/T4/T5/T6 + leaf-mount failures downstream (N8 affordance, N9 buy button, T17 source seed, N4 credits-line partially) | Vite `base` defaulted to `/`; dynamic imports + preload-dep hrefs resolve to `/assets/<chunk>.js` — nothing serves it (SPA assets live under `/assets/spa/*`). Signed-in preview legs never ran (the `rhema-nonprod-resend-api-key` blocker), so the class surfaced first on prod — exactly what Arm B exists to catch. **Fixed on `stevevitali/armb-1-spa-asset-base`** (`base: "/assets/spa/"`, top-level key — `build.base` is silently ignored). |
| **HARNESS GAP — forced-SSR verdicts** | N7, R5, P1.* settle-lapses: gated docs `/p/showcase` (+ phone-context `/p/showcase-copy`) reporting `ssr` under `--expect-renderer spa` | REQ-ED-12/ADR-108 makes SSR the CORRECT verdict for `showcase:true` rows + phone UAs — verified `showcase`/`showcase-copy` row flags in prod DB. The runner's gated-route assert had no model for the mandated carve-out. **Fixed in the same PR**: forced-SSR docs now self-report `<html data-ssr-cause="phone\|showcase">`; `awaitMounted` + the doc-response assert honor the stamp. An unstamped `ssr` on a gated route still fails. |
| **Owed — env** | R6F, T7, T12F, T13F need `JOURNEY_DATABASE_URL` (system-role DSN) | Owed, not failures — system-pool DSN leg not yet wired for this run. |
| **Owed — fixture/spec** | T8 (7-day token vs purge timing), T3 (D-STB.5a-2), N4's credits-line half (EST.1/ACT.1 selector drift, already ledgered) | Unchanged dispositions — re-triaged after the redeploy re-run. |

## 7 — Residual triage (root-caused live, DB-bound)

| Leg | Verdict |
|---|---|
| **T5** | Deterministic `net::ERR_ABORTED` on the presign→GCS PUT — **benign artifact, code-fixed**. The object landed byte-complete both times (`quarantine/…` 1198 B verified in the bucket); the `quarantineKey` chain completed (connection row `status=ok`, `handle` = the PUT key). Cause proven by live repro: `fetch()` resolves on headers, neither upload site consumed `put.body`, Chromium held the request until the step's next `goto` aborted it. Consuming the body flips the same probe to `requestfinished`. |
| **N8** | Harness race, not a product gap: `waitForURL` resolves on the SPA client-nav while `/bff/p/:slug` is still in flight; `a[data-edit-source]` attaches ~1 s later (measured live). Fixed in ARMB.2 — wait-for-attach before the count. |
| **N4** | Tracked pre-existing drift (D-OBS.1-3): trial tenants render the `data-included` variant; `sheetFigure`'s waiting `textContent("[data-credits-line]")` threw before its own Included fallback. Fixed in ARMB.2 — count-probe first, matrix-cell fallback intact (the SPA emits `data-estimate-matrix` too). |
| **T7** | Harness race: probed before the pg-boss `send-it` commit landed; the job row exists now (`project.purge:01M4XHR0CPVTCYTG5DZR89GZR8`, `start_after` +30 d — verified via `rhema_project_purge_schedule`). Fixed in ARMB.2 — 15 s probe poll. |
| **N9** | Tracked fixture drift (D-OBS.1-3): the jrn-a billing sub sits on the stale account after the 10-02 re-provision; top-up forms correctly gate on a paid plan. Needs the prod-data repair — operator. |
| **T3** | Unchanged — D-STB.5a-2. |
| **T17** | Owed (expected red) — source-view seeding; unchanged. |
| **R6F** | My rerun artifact: `--steps` without `--surface` scoped the renderer assert at `/signup` (a forever-SSR funnel doc). Owed reason now read live. |
| **T12F / T13F** | Owed — DB-bound this time; real assertions now visible (obligated-notice / fixture regressed), same dispositions. |

## 9 — ARMB.2 live verification (d5a74cc, 2026-10-15)

Harness fixes verified live against the deployed `d5a74cc` (harness-only — no image needed):

- **N4** PASS — `data-included` trial variant handled by the count-probe fallback.
- **T7** PASS — the 15 s poll catches the `send-it` commit.
- **N8** PASS (leg A) after the click-target fix: `page.click("[data-page-view]")` landed on the
  `contenteditable="false"` front-matter `<pre>` (geometric center), producing a NodeSelection
  that swallowed every keystroke — no transaction, no Y update, no fork (artifact forensics on
  v2 confirmed probes typed pre-handshake never reached the server's Y.Doc). Fixed: click the
  last editable paragraph before typing.
- **N8 leg-B — two more harness races found and fixed:**
  1. `/app`'s `a[href^="/p/"]` scan ran on the skeleton DOM (bare `evaluateAll` before the twin
     painted) — now waits for the first link to attach.
  2. The `/^\/p\/[^/]+$/` filter matched `?rename=1` row-actions — six rename links consumed half
     the `slice(0, 12)` scan window and cut `/p/showcase` before the readonly/dossier arm ran.
     Filter tightened to `[^/?#]+`.
  3. Per-page and dossier probes used bare `count()` on SPA leaves — now wait for
     `[data-page-host]`/`li[data-version-chip]`/`[data-ide-state]` and `[data-showcase-banner]`
     to attach before counting.
- Final: `PASS N8 [EDIT.1]` — leg B rode `/p/showcase` → dossier `01M4XCGEQ250TANHRSYXRNZ90R` →
  `[data-duplicate-form]` → `/v/working` fork+save, all under the SPA.
  Report `docs/build/reports/2026-10-15_ARMB2-n8-legb3/` (spend $0).

**No application defect found in the entire ARMB.2 residual set** — T5 was real-but-benign
(response-body hygiene, code-fixed); every other failure was harness timing or tracked fixture
